name: Exage 400LX four-finger brake lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 294 g for the complete BL-M350-B left/right four-finger brake lever pair with 22.2 mm clamps. The source explicitly states pair; no individual mass is doubled.

technical_document.title: Shimano 1991 dealer product manual, PDF page 72 / printed 69: Exage 400LX named range: ST-M050 explicitly 305 g four-finger pair, SL-M453 184 g per pair, BL-M350-B 294 g per pair, FC-M400 170 mm 48/38/28T 763 g and BR-M351
